parties.petitioner: Puja Ferro Alloys P.Ltd, M/s Karthik Alloys Ltd, Karthik Inductions Ltd, Global Ispat Ltd, Sunrise Electromelt Ltd

summary: Electricity tariff rebate dispute; 25% industrial rebate under 1991 notification; rescission in 1995; amendments in 1996 declared void ab initio for procedural non-compliance; rebate suspension challenged; High Court upheld demand notices under 2002 recovery Act; Supreme Court examines retrospective recovery, promissory estoppel, validity of amendments and notifications; rebate entitlement limited to pre-1995 applicants; amendments invalid; recovery under 2002 Act upheld for beneficiaries of void notifications; final disposal of long-pending litigation.
legal_provisions_cited: Goa (Prohibition of Further Payments and Recovery of Rebate Benefits) Act, 2002 s.3
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; impugned judgment and order upholding demand notices under the 2002 Act affirmed; recovery of rebate amounts paid under void notifications permitted.
